meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: Claude 会检查或配置 claude-mem 的云端同步:查询本地 worker 的同步状态,或把你从 cmem.ai → Connect 拿到的三个连接值写进设置文件,重启 worker 后验证是否连上 SyncHub。同步会上传观察叙述和完整提示词到你的 cmem.ai 账户。
howto.when: 当你说「set up cloud sync」、「sync my memories」等关键词,或想查看同步状态、把记忆库备份或同步到 cmem.ai 账户时触发。

say.text: 检查一下我的记忆云同步状态
say.note: 查询本地 worker 的同步状态并报告

say.text: 用我的 cmem.ai Pro 账户设置 cloud sync
say.note: 会向你要 cmem.ai → Connect 上的三个连接值

say.text: 把我的记忆库备份同步到 cmem.ai 账户
say.note: 写入连接值、重启 worker 并验证 SyncHub

howto.what_en: Claude checks or sets up claude-mem cloud sync: it reads the worker's sync status, or writes the three values from cmem.ai → Connect to settings, then restarts and verifies SyncHub. It uploads observations and prompts to cmem.ai.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cloud backup" and similar, or ask for sync status or backing up your memories to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.text: Check my memory cloud sync status
say_en.note: Queries the local worker's sync status

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync with my cmem.ai Pro account
say_en.note: Asks you for the three connection values

say_en.text: Back up and sync my memories to my cmem.ai account
say_en.note: Writes values, restarts the worker, verifies
